description: This file declares the GstDecryptorElementFactory class, which implements the IGstDecryptorElementFactory interface. It provides a factory method to create decryptor elements for GStreamer pipelines, specific to the Rialto server component.

classes.name: GstDecryptorElementFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating decryptor elements within the Rialto server's GStreamer pipeline.

methods.description: Default constructor for the factory class.
